// diagnostic

E0395

A channel capacity must be at least 1, not `{capacity}`.

What

A channel capacity must be at least 1, not `{capacity}`.

Why

A bounded channel holds at least one value; Jet has no zero-capacity rendezvous channel, and a capacity below 1 is never clamped. A runtime capacity below 1 stops the program (E3001).

Fix

Write `channel<T>(capacity: 1)` or larger, or `channel<T>()` for an unbounded channel.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0395: tests/ui/channel_capacity_below_one.stderr.

  --> channel_capacity_below_one.jet:2:36
    |
  2 |     zero := channel<Int>(capacity: 0)
    |                                    ^
 Why: A bounded channel holds at least one value; Jet has no zero-capacity rendezvous channel, and a capacity below 1 is never clamped. A runtime capacity below 1 stops the program (E3001).
 Fix: Write `channel<T>(capacity: 1)` or larger, or `channel<T>()` for an unbounded channel.
